label: Kimi K3.1 Pro
output:
**To whoever has been dumping rubbish in the bin at 14 Aughrim Terrace**

Apologies to the rest of the terrace for putting this through every letterbox, but I don’t know which house or car is involved, and this needs to stop.

For roughly a month now, someone has been filling my grey bin with bags of their own rubbish every week. This isn’t the odd wrapper or one small bag when there’s space going spare. It’s full black bags.

When I got home around 3am after a gig last Tuesday, the lid wouldn’t even close because there were three black bags in it that weren’t mine. One contained nappies. I also found a gas bill envelope in one of the bags. The name had been torn off, but “Aughrim Terrace” was still on it. A neighbour across the road saw a car pull up on Tuesday evening, though they didn’t see who was in it. So whoever it is, you know exactly what you’re doing.

Just so there’s no confusion: it’s the Greenmount Bins grey bin with **14 painted on the lid in white**. It goes out on Tuesday night and is collected on Wednesday morning.

I pay for this bin by weight, at **41c per kilo**. My bill is usually around **€25 for two months**. The last one was **€63.20**. I’m not paying for your crap anymore. I rent here, I pay my own way, and I expect other people to do the same.

If you’re genuinely stuck and don’t know how to get rubbish collected, knock on my door and ask. I’ll tell you who to ring. It’s not hard. Sneaking over under cover of darkness and leaving me with the cost and the hassle is a different story entirely.

I work nights, I’m absolutely fuming about this, and I’m not a pushover. Whoever is doing it: **stop. Simple as that.**

If another load appears, I’ll start padlocking the bin. I shouldn’t have to lock up my own wheelie bin to stop someone else treating it as a free dump, but here we are.

To everyone else, thanks for reading — and if you happened to notice anything else last Tuesday evening, I’d appreciate you letting me know at No. 14.

**No. 14, Aughrim Terrace**
